thread:
alex: Quick heads-up — docs PR ready for the SDK batching migration, needs merge before feature-flag cutoff (Wed Mar 5 EOD PST). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2107. Changes move /docs/sdk/batching.md -> /docs/sdk/batching_v2.md. Requesting reviewers @maria @tim. Preview currently failing due to an image link.

maria: On it. I'll check the TOC/versioned nav update. Do we need redirects for old paths?

tim: Confirming cutoff = 2025-03-05 23:59 PST. If CI is green + preview OK, plan to merge Tue/Wed to give time for canary.

ci-bot: ci/status: PR2107 tests: 12 passed, 2 flaky, docs-preview: failed (broken image link). Logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/9887

alex: The broken image is the new diagram path; I pushed a fix to the PR but netlify hasn't rebuilt yet. Can someone trigger a preview re-run?

jen: re-run kicked off (manual). Will post the preview link when ready.

maria: Also added redirect guidance in the PR: suggested _redirects entry:```/sdk/batching /sdk/batching_v2 301``` — this preserves old links and helps versioned nav.

tim: Good call on redirects. Also need a short migration blurb for release notes. Alex, can you draft a 2-3 sentence note we can copy to CHANGELOG?

alex: Done — added to PR description under 'Migration notes' and appended to the changelog draft: "SDK batching v2 renames keys; old configs continue to work behind feature flag for two weeks."

ci-bot: preview/build: rebuild complete — success. Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-2107--redwood-docs.netlify.app. All tests now passed.

maria: Reviewed and approved. Left one tiny nit on the code snippet formatting (inline vs fenced). @alex can you squash the extra commits and rebase onto main for a clean merge?

alex: Squashed & pushed. Rebased on main to pick up the TOC fix.

tim: Looks good from release side. I'll do the final merge Wed 09:00 PST unless anyone objects.

ci-bot: merge/status: PR2107 merged to main and staging build scheduled. Staging deploy started.

alex: :shipit: Thanks everyone — I'll post the migration note to the support channel and update the docs checklist for the post-merge follow-ups.
